questions.question: A and B together can do a piece of work in 21 days. B and C together can do it in 24 days. A and C together can do it in 33 days. In how many days approximately will A, B and C finish it together?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(21, 24, 33) = 1848 units.

Combined efficiency of 2(A + B + C) = (1848 ÷ 21) + (1848 ÷ 24) + (1848 ÷ 33) = 88 + 77 + 56 = 221.

Efficiency of (A + B + C) = 221 ÷ 2 = 110.5 units/day.

Time taken by A, B and C together = 1848 ÷ 110.5 ≈ 16.72 days.

Rounding off to the nearest integer, we get 17 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 17 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by (A + B) = 21 days

Time taken by (B + C) = 24 days

Time taken by (C + A) = 33 days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total efficiency of 2(A + B + C) = 88 + 77 + 56

⇒ 2(A + B + C) = 221

⇒ Efficiency of (A + B + C) = 221 ÷ 2 = 110.5 units/day

⇒ Time required for A, B, and C together = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of (A + B + C)

⇒ Time required = 1848 ÷ 110.5 = 16.72 days

⇒ Approximate time taken = 17 days

**∴ The correct answer is 17 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Work Concept

Total work is universally considered as the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of the given number of days. This prevents complicated fractions and keeps efficiency values as simple integers.

Combined Work Rule

When individuals work in cyclic pairs like (A+B), (B+C), and (C+A), summing their individual group efficiencies gives exactly twice the total efficiency of all individuals working together. Always divide this sum by 2 to find the net efficiency of A + B + C.

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in the exact ratio of the work done by each person. If all participants work for the exact same total number of days, the wages can be directly distributed in the ratio of their individual efficiencies.

questions.question: A and B together can do a piece of work in 20 days, while B alone can finish it in 25 days. How many days will A take to complete the same work alone?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Work done by A and B in 20 days

Work done by B alone in 25 days

**Concept:**

The difference of reciprocals of times taken by two entities working together and one entity alone gives the work rate of the other entity.

**Solution:**

Work rate of A and B together = 1/20

Work rate of B alone = 1/25

Work rate of A alone = (1/20) - (1/25) ⇒ 0.01

Time taken by A to complete the work alone = 1/0.01 ⇒ 100 days

**Therefore, A will take 100 days to complete the same work alone.**

questions.question: Priya allows 5 percent discount on the marked price of her goods and still earns a profit of 18 percent. What is the cost price of an item, if its marked price is Rs. 944?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Discount allowed on the marked price: 5%

Profit earned: 18%

The marked price of the item: Rs. 944

**Concept:**

The cost price of an item can be calculated from the formula, Marked Price = Cost Price × (1 + Profit% / 100)/(1 - Discount%/100)

**Solution:**

Put the given values into the formula:

944 = Cost Price × (1 + 18/100)/(1 - 5/100)

⇒ Cost Price = Rs. 760

**Therefore, the cost price of the item is Rs. 760.**

questions.question: Find the fourth proportional of 3 hours 20 minutes, 1 hour 50 minutes, and 6 hours 20 minutes.
questions.solution:
**Given**

Proportional numbers: 3 hours 20 minutes (200 minutes), 1 hour 50 minutes (110 minutes), 6 hours 20 minutes (380 minutes)

**Concept:**

If a:b = c:d, then d = b × c/a (fourth proportional)

Solution:

Convert all times to minutes.

Substitute the values into the formula: d = 110 × 380/200 ⇒ d = 209 minutes = 3 hours 29 minutes

**Therefore, the fourth proportional is 3 hours 29 minutes (209 minutes).**

questions.question: In a circular race of 5000 m, starting from the same point, the speeds of two contestants A and B are 36 km/h and 54 km/h, respectively. The difference between the time taken (in seconds) to meet for the first time when they are running in the opposite directions and when they are running in the same direction?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Circular race length: 5000 m

Speed of A: 36 km/h (or 10 m/s)

Speed of B: 54 km/h (or 15 m/s)

**Concept:**

Time = Distance/Speed. In opposite directions, the speeds add up; in the same direction, they subtract.

**Solution:**

Time taken when running in opposite directions = 5000/(10 + 15) ⇒ 200 seconds

Time taken when running in the same direction = 5000/(15 - 10) ⇒ 1000 seconds

The difference in times = 1000 - 200 ⇒ 800 seconds

**Therefore, the difference between the times taken to meet for the first time in opposite and the same directions is 800 seconds.**

questions.question: A ream of 500 pages is bought for ₹280, and packets of 25 pages are made from it. Each packet is sold for ₹18. Find the percentage profit or loss. (Rounded off up to one decimal place).
questions.solution:
**Given**

Cost of 500 pages: ₹280

Selling price of 25 pages: ₹18

**Concept:**

Profit% = (Selling Price - Cost Price) / Cost Price * 100%

**Solution:**

Cost price of 25 pages = (280 / 500) × 25 ⇒ ₹14

Profit for 25 pages = 18 - 14 ⇒ ₹4

Profit% = (4 / 14) × 100% ⇒ approximately 28.6% profit

**Therefore, the profit percentage is approximately 28.6%.**

questions.question: The diameter of a hemisphere is 6 cm. The ratio of the magnitudes of its curved surface area to the total surface area is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Diameter of the hemisphere: 6 cm

**Concept:**

Ratio of curved surface area (2πr²) to total surface area (3πr²) of a hemisphere.

**Solution:**

The ratio of curved surface area to total surface area of a hemisphere is 2:3.

**Therefore, the ratio of the magnitudes of its curved surface area to the total surface area is 2 : 3.**

questions.question: Find the sum of the digits of the greatest number that can exactly divide 288 and 432.
questions.solution:
**Given**

Numbers: 288, 432

**Concept:**

The greatest number that can exactly divide two or more numbers is their Highest Common Factor (HCF). The sum of digits can be found by adding the digits of the number.

**Solution:**

HCF of 288 and 432 ⇒ 144

Sum of digits of 144 = 1 + 4 + 4 ⇒ 9

**Therefore, the sum of the digits of the greatest number that can exactly divide 288 and 432 is 9.**

questions.question: Three number are in the ratio of 4 ∶ 5 ∶ 6, and their LCM is 180. Their HCF is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the common multiplier be x, which acts as the HCF of the numbers.

LCM of 4x, 5x, and 6x = x × LCM(4, 5, 6) = 60x.

Given LCM = 180 ⇒ 60x = 180 ⇒ x = 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9b5e8bcf3ff1bad0a8d5809da1c5c0c3c65e87ae1ddb5d6ba823663be27c2dd.png] 

**Given:**

⇒ Ratio of three numbers = 4 ∶ 5 ∶ 6

⇒ LCM of the numbers = 180

**Concept Used:**

⇒ If numbers are given in a ratio, their common multiplier 'x' represents their Highest Common Factor (HCF).

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the actual numbers be 4x, 5x, and 6x.

⇒ LCM of 4, 5, and 6 = 60

⇒ Therefore, the LCM of 4x, 5x, and 6x = 60x

⇒ We are given that their overall LCM is 180.

⇒ 60x = 180

⇒ x = 180 ÷ 60

⇒ x = 3

⇒ Since x is the common multiplier, the HCF of the numbers is 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM and HCF Relationship

For any two numbers 'a' and 'b', the product of the numbers is equal to the product of their LCM and HCF. Formula: a × b = LCM(a, b) × HCF(a, b). This rule does not directly extend to three numbers.

Co-prime Numbers

If the HCF of two or more numbers is 1, they are called co-prime numbers. For mutually co-prime numbers, their LCM is simply the product of the given numbers.

Ratio Multiplier as HCF

When numbers are expressed in their simplest simplified ratio, the common multiplier 'x' required to obtain the actual original numbers represents their Highest Common Factor (HCF).

questions.question: If ratio of X to Y is 3 ∶ 4, then determine the relation between X and Y.

options.text: Both X is 75 percent of Y and Y is 133.33 percent of X

questions.solution:
**Given**

Ratio of X to Y: 3:4

**Concept:**

The relation between X and Y in terms of percentage can be calculated using the ratio.

**Solution:**

X is (3/4) × 100 = 75% of Y

Y is (4/3) × 100 ≈ 133.33% of X

**Therefore, both X is 75 percent of Y and Y is 133.33 percent of X.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper offers three successive discounts of 15%, 30% and 4% on an article. If the article is marked at ₹1,950, what is its selling price (in ₹, rounded off to the nearest tens)?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Marked price of an article: ₹1,950

Discounts offered: 15%, 30%, and 4%

**Concept:**

Successive discounts can be calculated by applying each discount one after the other.

**Solution:**

Price after first discount = 1950 - (15% of 1950) ⇒ ₹1657.5

Price after second discount = 1657.5 - (30% of 1657.5) ⇒ ₹1160.25

Price after third discount = 1160.25 - (4% of 1160.25) ⇒ ₹1113.84

**Therefore, the selling price of the article is approximately ₹1110 when rounded off to the nearest tens.**

questions.question: The average of sales of an electronics shop in the years 2001, 2002, 2003 and 2004 is 1850, and that for the years 2002, 2003, 2004 and 2005 is 2125. If the sales in 2005 are1200, then find the sales in 2001?

The population of a village increases by 12½ % in the first year and decrease by 8% in the second year. If the present population of village is 3200, then what will be the population of the village after 2 years?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Initial population: 3200

Increase in first year: 12.5%

Decrease in second year: 8%

**Concept:**

Population change can be calculated by applying the percentage increase or decrease to the current population.

**Solution:**

Population after first year = 3200 + (12.5% of 3200) ⇒ 3600

Population after second year = 3600 - (8% of 3600) ⇒ 3312

**Therefore, the population of the village after 2 years will be 3312.**

questions.question: Determine the fourth proportional to 11.6 m, 9.2 m, 32.8 m. (Consider up to two decimals)
questions.solution:
**Given**

Proportional numbers: 11.6 m, 9.2 m, 32.8 m

**Concept:**

If a:b = c:d, then d = b * c / a (fourth proportional)

**Solution:**

Substitute the values into the formula: d = 9.2 × 32.8/11.6 ⇒ d = 26.01 m

**Therefore, the fourth proportional is 26.01 m.**

questions.question: A, B and C run on a circular track. Time taken by A, B, and C to complete one round are 6 min, 8 min and 3 min respectively. If they start together at 5 p.m., then at what time will they meet again at the starting point?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Time taken by A, B, and C to complete one round: 6 min, 8 min, 3 min respectively

**Concept:**

The time they will meet again at the starting point will be the least common multiple (LCM) of their individual times.

**Solution:**

LCM of 6, 8, and 3 minutes = 24 minutes

They started at 5:00 p.m. so they will meet again at 5:00 p.m. + 24 minutes ⇒ 5:24 p.m.

**Therefore, they will meet again at the starting point at 5:24 p.m.**

questions.question: If the radius of the base and the slant height of a cone are 17 cm and 25 cm respectively, then what is the total surface area of the cone?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Radius of the cone (r): 17 cm

Slant height of the cone (l): 25 cm

**Concept:**

Total surface area of a cone = πr(l + r)

**Solution:**

Substitute the given values into the formula: Total surface area = π × 17 × (25 + 17)

⇒ Total surface area = 2244 cm²

**Therefore, the total surface area of the cone is 2244 cm².**

questions.question: Afzal's monthly income is Rs. 35,000. He spends 20% of his monthly income on food, 30% on clothes, and 15% on rent. How much money does Afzal save monthly?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Afzal's monthly income: ₹35,000

Percentage of income spent on food: 20%

Percentage of income spent on clothes: 30%

Percentage of income spent on rent: 15%

**Concept:**

Monthly savings can be calculated by subtracting the total expenditure from the total income.

**Solution:**

Total expenditure = 20% of ₹35,000 (for food) + 30% of ₹35,000 (for clothes) + 15% of ₹35,000 (for rent) ⇒ ₹22,750

Monthly savings = ₹35,000 - ₹22,750 ⇒ ₹12,250

**Therefore, Afzal saves ₹12,250 monthly.**

questions.question: A woman gains 30 percent by selling an article for a certain price. If she sells it at double price, then the profit made is :
questions.solution:
**Given**

Profit on selling an article for a certain price: 30%

**Concept:**

If the selling price is doubled, the profit percentage will also be doubled.

**Solution:**

Profit when the selling price is doubled = 30% × 2 ⇒ 60%

So total profit made = 160%

**Therefore, the profit made when the article is sold at double the price is 160%.**

questions.question: The average of 11 numbers is 7.5. What should be the 12th number added to them to make the average 8.5?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Average of 11 numbers: 7.5

Desired average after adding the 12th number: 8.5

**Concept:**

The 12th number can be found by multiplying the desired average by 12 and then subtracting the sum of the first 11 numbers.

**Solution:**

Sum of first 11 numbers = 7.5 × 11 ⇒ 82.5

12th number = 8.5 × 12 - 82.5 ⇒ 19.5

**Therefore, the 12th number should be 19.5 to make the average 8.5.**

questions.question: Find the compound interest on Rs. 3,00,000, compounded half-yearly, for 2(1)/(2) years at the rate of 20% per annum.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Half-yearly rate = 20% ÷ 2 = 10% (1/10) and Time = 2.5 × 2 = 5 cycles.

For 5 cycles, P = 10⁵ = 100000 units, A = 11⁵ = 161051 units.

Compound Interest (CI) = 161051 − 100000 = 61051 units.

Since P = 100000 units = Rs. 3,00,000, Total CI = 61051 × 3 = Rs. 1,83,153.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1,83,153.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Principal (P) = Rs. 3,00,000

⇒ Rate of interest (R) = 20% per annum

⇒ Time (T) = 2.5 years

**Formula Used:**

⇒ A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5dfdcefdfa1e4503188153d36cb3e3121ce34446832030451b92d811ce875048.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Since interest is compounded half-yearly, Rate = 20% ÷ 2 = 10%

⇒ Number of conversion periods (n) = 2.5 × 2 = 5

⇒ A = 3,00,000 × (1 + 10/100)⁵

⇒ A = 3,00,000 × (11/10)⁵

⇒ A = 3,00,000 × (161051 / 100000)

⇒ A = 3 × 161051 = 4,83,153

⇒ Compound Interest (CI) = A − P

⇒ CI = 4,83,153 − 3,00,000 = 1,83,153

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1,83,153.**

**__Additional Information__**

Half-yearly Compounding

When interest is compounded half-yearly, the given annual rate is divided by 2, and the total time period in years is multiplied by 2.

Quarterly Compounding

When interest is compounded quarterly, the given annual rate is divided by 4, and the time period is multiplied by 4.

Successive Multiplication Factor

Amount can be directly calculated using successive multiplying factors based on rate fractions. For a 10% rate, the multiplying factor is 11/10 per cycle.
</p
